scope.publicScope: Native save/flag values only; no protocol keys or project references in public tables.

sources.note: Interface contains only key/display/force_val; definitions live in src/ui/debug.c.
Human-readable catalog; compared with item definitions rather than treated as native enum truth.
Save base, packed-bit macros, typed fields and flags; table use_max/cached values are internal policy, not native value meanings.
32-bit fish counters, Ushiwaka quest flags, native target counts 3/5/8.
Recruitment field offsets/widths and nonzero selection semantics.
Current HP low byte and saved/runtime lives; configuration enum is excluded.
Menu changes do not modify save flags; no D_8015C608 mappings added from this project.

ghidra.note: Getter returns byte & mask, not normalized boolean; byte index masked by 0xFF.
Setter ORs selected bit into computed byte; unrelated bits preserved.
Live decompile plus disassembly confirms clear 0x304, SW fields +64,+78,+70,+6C,+74,+90,+94,+98,+C4; SB +206; SH +204,+20A,+20C,+20E,+210 and defaults.
Copies 0x30 bytes from base+64 to runtime mirror and full 0x304 into backup.
Native character selection checks recruitment words for nonzero.
Decrements runtime lives at 0x8015C5EC then tests against zero.
Native spawn read copies +204 room, +208 rotation, +20A X, +20C Y, +20E Z, +210 camera rotation.
Scans nonzero words starting 0x8015C8AC (base+2A4), then passes count to map/display setup. Does not establish per-index warp names.
Native menu/map code checks base+268 and +26C arrays and scans base+2A4 nonzero words. Large function has decompiler overlap warning; no additional exact per-slot interpretation inferred.

excludedAssumptions: The catalog force_val and item use_max/cached fields are not native enum values.
Custom names beginning fl_, ky_, lk_, cs_, sd_, gd_ are not exposed as native C symbols.
The 0x304-byte save block size does not make every byte an independently safe event flag.
Warp-location aliases for +2A4..+2D4 do not establish native per-index meaning; preserved only internally as candidates.
No boss-rush unlock meaning is assigned to this save-base symbol from unrelated menu task states.
